Предвидено е възлагането и изпълнението на конкретни видове и количества работи по предмета на поръчката и съответните им единични цени да се определят в договорите, които ще бъдат сключени след подписване на РС и след провеждане на предвидените по ЗОП обществени поръчки. The subject ITT addresses part of the PROSPECT Drilling and Sample Analysis package
 development (managed by Leonardo as Prime), due for flight on board the Russian 
Luna-Resource (Luna-27) mission in 2022. As part of PROSPECT an Imaging System 
is foreseen which shall deliver images of drilling and sampling operations. 
This Imaging System is composed of 3 main elements: 
1) a Camera Unit (CU), 2) an Artificial Illumination Unit (AIU) and 
3) an Imaging Support and Interface Unit (ISIU). 

The Camera Unit has been subjected to ITT AO130114 and shall be considered 
as a CFI for the present ITT, whose subject is targeted specifically at Artificial 
Illumination Unit (AIU) and Imaging Support & Interface Unit (ISIU). 

The Camera Unit will acquire static images and video footage of drilling and sampling
operations under both artificial illumination and natural sunlight conditions. 
The AIU and ISIU shall support the Camera Unit providing with proper support, 
interface and artificial illumination.

This procurement aims to identify and / or develop hardware of high technical 
maturity which can fulfil the requirements and which is compatible with the 
cost and schedule constraints of the project. 

The Contractor is also required to support the Prime Contractor responsible by providing
 relevant data associated with the Imaging System HW, to support via HW testing the
 verification of the performance, and to supply Engineering Model HW which can be
 used in overall system tests. This work shall be carried out within the overall scope 
of the running PROSPECT Phase B+ activity.
